query: I went to a local bakery this morning and tried their new matcha croissant, it was so buttery and had just the right amount of matcha sweetness, I even bought a second one to eat tomorrow. Then on my way back to the hotel I stopped at a little street market and picked up a hand-painted ceramic mug that has a cute little cat illustration on the side, it’s already become my favorite thing I’ve bought on this trip. I also spent an hour wandering around the old town square earlier, watching street performers play folk music and people take photos with the old clock tower. Anyway I need help figuring out why my MMS won’t send at all right now, my APN MMS settings seem to be messed up, I have my mobile data mode turned off completely, I already used up all my data for the billing cycle, I’m traveling abroad right now and I have data roaming turned off too.
